choice.basis: The dashboard shows May's output as a near-zero sliver (visually well below the 10,000 MWh mark), while every other displayed month ranges from roughly 17,500 to 40,000 MWh. This is an extreme, order-of-magnitude outlier relative to the peer months, which fits the definition of a critical low-output anomaly rather than a routine low-output case. The third option (background filing) is inappropriate because the data clearly indicates a significant issue requiring review.
choice.option_label: Escalate May to critical low-output anomaly review
